description: [Legacy Cloud Outbound Mailer API — merged into SENS on 2026-09-17; available only to projects migrated from Cloud Outbound Mailer and only for ~12 months (SENS overview: until Dec 2027). New mail sending/lookup: ncloud_sens_send_mail / ncloud_sens_list_mail_requests.] Get the address book summary (GET /address-book): totalAddressCount and per-group sid/groupName/addressCount. There is no API to list the individual addresses of a group.
